content.description: Diagram showing a quarter window glass piece with a dam placement indicated

items: (a) Apply double-stick tape at a point 12 mm (0.47 in.) from the glass rim.
(b) Place dam on the double-stick tape.

content.description: Illustration showing hands applying primer to glass adhering surface using a sponge and primer bottle

content.text: 4. COAT CONTACT SURFACE OF GLASS WITH PRIMER

items: (a) Using a sponge, coat the glass adhering surface with primer.
(b) Let the primer coating dry for 10 minutes.

content.description: Overhead view diagram showing liquid sealer application pattern around quarter window glass, with Interior Side marked on both left and right sides

items: (a) Attach the cushions around the glass.

content.text: NOTE: Install the cushions facing as shown.

items: (b) Coat the spacer with the sealer.

content.description: Cross-sectional detail diagram showing butyl tape and sealer application measurements around glass edge, with dimensions marked: 4 mm (0.16 in.) in two locations, 8 mm (0.31 in.), and 20-30 mm (0.79-1.18 in.)

items: (c) Apply butyl tape on the glass.
(d) Tape over 20 mm (0.79 in.) of the rear area.

content.description: Illustration showing hands installing quarter window glass into vehicle body opening from interior

items: (e) Align the hole of rear area with the glass and body when installing the glass onto the body.
(f) To seat the glass, tap from the inside with the palm of your hand.
(g) Install the glass retainers around the glass.
